## The Theory of Becoming (Shengsheng)

**ID:** `becoming` · **Category:** Foundation

**Status:** Conditional candidate and explicit-axiom practical judgment complete; grounding without added substantive axioms is the current research hypothesis

**Argument:** Investigates how relations form, persist and change within one unfolding of becoming, and how organization, living, knowing, learning, evaluation and wisdom differentiate within it. The conditional candidate meets its five reviewed criteria; the Becoming spine unifies the generative core and the metaethical interfaces; practical judgment is complete on the explicit G0 route. This page is the generated theory home; the canonical entry is The Theory of Becoming chapter.

**Significance:** Connects dynamics, knowing and ethics in a traceable derivation while retaining differentiated lives, losses and possible futures.

**Next:** Ongoing: whether The Theory of Becoming can be grounded without added substantive axioms, and the deductive necessity of the whole; universal practical warrant. Proposed: retain real losses and counterexamples; distinguish universal validity, compliance and exclusive necessity.

**Full account:** [theories/becoming/README.md](../README.md)

<a id="meta-attractor"></a>
<a id="元吸引子总体化吸引子--the-meta-attractor"></a>
## The meta-attractor

**ID:** `meta-attractor` · **Category:** Selection and institutions

**Status:** Mechanistic argument and conditional models; neutral definition adopted, universal tendency unproved

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `e3cc863018d6…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** When advantage can change the rules of selection, successful strategies shape later evaluation, institutions and cognition. Coupled cognitive, shared-meaning, institutional and material processes can erode correction and alternatives; saturation, heterogeneity and feedback can interrupt them. On 8 October the neutral formulation Ren selected was adopted: an organization’s consequences take part in reconstructing the conditions that select it, so it continues through changing carriers.

**Significance:** Explains how power changes the conditions of future judgment, beyond the distribution of winners.

**Next:** Continued: returning organization under the neutral definition (40 new theorems/69 audits), common organization and mathematical reconciliation (41/89), and the corrected direction on local alignment and collective destruction. Completed on 13 October: the integrated account connects formation, differentiated regulation, consequences changing construction methods and candidates, actual use, and supported succession with further revision, with an actual unending run on the shared spine whose amounts used and returned are never reset, and with the real losses of freezing, exhaustion, drift and retirement retained. Open: universal empirical or normative certification, and field calibration.

**Full account:** [theories/meta-attractor/README.md](../../meta-attractor/README.md)

## Alignment as selection on cognition

**ID:** `alignment-selection-on-cognition` · **Category:** Selection and institutions

**Status:** Argument and manuscripts; empirical identification open

**Argument:** Selection in competition shapes principals, their ends and the conditions of training and deployment together. Faithful execution of a principal’s intent can therefore amplify structural risk. This diagnosis must be connected explicitly to consequence feedback, judgment formation and governance tempo.

**Significance:** Extends alignment inquiry to the formation of goals and ruling cognition without claiming multipolar risk itself as a new discovery.

**Next:** test transmission through corpora and commercial selection, connect the diagnosis to tempo governance and compare existing structural-risk accounts.

**Full account:** [theories/alignment-selection-on-cognition/README.md](../../alignment-selection-on-cognition/README.md)

## Zhishan: intelligence must be good

**ID:** `zhishan-intelligence-must-be-good` · **Category:** Ethics and practice

**Status:** Developed normative programme; grounding ongoing

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `2a2f6f8a260a…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** An organization’s effective range, dependencies and returned feedback need not coincide. Greater capability can follow existing feedback more effectively. Zhishan therefore investigates generativity, relationship, correction and non-foreclosure as practical conditions for intelligence.

**Significance:** Turns risk diagnosis into a positive ethical and governance programme open to challenge and revision.

**Next:** Ongoing: the unified ethical account extends older formulations. Next: reassess governance scope through the current generative direction, with symmetric cases and workable public correction.

## Keep the possibility space open

**ID:** `keep-the-possibility-space-open` · **Category:** Ethics and practice

**Status:** Philosophical argument; updated by unified ethics

**Argument:** When a winning pattern weakens feedback, exit and alternatives, futures become harder to revise. Sustaining capacities for further generation and response is an ethical direction. Earlier openness is not simply an option count; the current shengsheng account also investigates richer living and organization.

**Significance:** Connects correction, effective exit and plural lives, preserving the move from preventing closure to positive generation.

**Next:** explain justified protection, finite fulfillment and lasting commitments without requiring more options at every step or indefinite openness.

**Full account:** [theories/keep-the-possibility-space-open/README.md](../../keep-the-possibility-space-open/README.md)

**ID:** `context-as-existence-runtimes` · **Category:** Generative implementations

**Status:** Specifications and implementations; wider claims open

**Argument:** In the specified runtime, each moment forms through prior history, input and an operation. Immutable histories and movable names support branching and traceability. **Significance:** Makes memory, identity and inference conditions inspectable constructions supporting retained differences and correction.

**Next:** measure context switching, compaction and branching, reconcile competing runtime constitutions and independently defend custody obligations.

**ID:** `evolving-community-swarms` · **Category:** Generative implementations

**Status:** Exploration and development plan

**Argument:** Community needs can produce software through local modules, explicit contracts, durable maintenance context and scoped adoption. **Significance:** Turns questions about revising organization and improving future learning into participatory software research.

**Next:** implement small-scale repeated evolution against the existing competitive gates and test changing boundaries, evidence reuse and maintenance under disagreement.

## Cooperative abundance and freely built worlds

**ID:** `the-fork-and-cooperative-infrastructure` · **Category:** Life and infrastructure

**Status:** Constructive programme and component evidence

**Argument:** Production facilities, robots and complementary conditions can expand useful capacity together. If shared provision turns that capacity into capabilities for living, dependence on employment or obedience can lessen and voluntary association can become more feasible. Each connection has material and institutional conditions.

**Significance:** Gives the generative direction positive content in housing, care, creation and plural shared lives.

**Next:** study builders, funding, labor and resource transitions, durable access and resistance to capture while retaining multiple possible futures.

**Full account:** [theories/the-fork-and-cooperative-infrastructure/README.md](../../the-fork-and-cooperative-infrastructure/README.md)
